resources.string: Report local civic issues with real photographs and GPS. When others support your complaint, its priority rises without artificial duplicates.
Municipal corporation unresolved counts increase ONLY when complaint emails are confirmed delivered by the mail system.
A problem leaves the unresolved count only after resolution evidence is independently verified. No secret closures.
NagrikVoice requires GPS location to verify the exact physical location of civic issues and route complaints to the responsible municipal authority.
Photographs must be captured through the in-app camera to preserve genuine timestamps and authenticity.
